{

  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI on reference Oxygen Not Included assemblies

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]

    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:

      uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v2

      run: msbuild -t:restore -property:Configuration=Release
    - name: Build project
      run: msbuild -t:rebuild -property:Configuration=Release -property:GameFolder="../Lib"",
  "rationale": "Added a custom job timeout of 10 minutes to bound runaway builds. The workflow previously had no timeout (default 6 hours), which could waste CI resources if a build hangs. Evidence from pattern P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (literature simulation estimate: 8.1% paid VM time reduction) and experiment batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508 (26.8% elapsed savings) supports this optimization. The 10-minute limit provides ample headroom over observed run times (~3-4 minutes) while preventing excessive resource consumption.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
